+### Status codes of `POST /api/transfers`
+
+| Status | Cause |
+| --- | --- |
+| 201 | The transfer was posted. |
+| 200 | A replay: the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same body as an earlier request; the first result is returned with `"replayed": true`. |
+| 400 | The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or blank, the amount is not a number or has too many decimals for the currency, or the ledger refuses the transfer (for example the same source and destination). |
+| 401 | No demo customer is chosen for the session. |
+| 404 | The source account is not owned by the session customer, or the destination account does not exist, is not a customer account or has another currency. |
+| 409 | The source account has insufficient funds. |
+| 422 | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different request, or the body does not pass validation. |
